subject: Request for temporary Net60 + credit increase; EU VAT evidence needed
messages:
From: Jenny Park <finance@lumoshealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendes <cfo@lumoshealth.com>, Oliver Reed <vatteam@brighttax.co.uk>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary Net60 and credit increase (Q2 usage spike)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last month — usage has ramped faster than expected. Our finance team is asking for a temporary extension to Net60 for Redwood invoices for the next three billing cycles to line up with our internal collection calendar. Separately, given the Q2 forecast (~$420k runway on your platform) we need a one-time credit limit increase while we finalize our corporate credit memo. Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 

- Move to Net60 on signed invoices for Apr–Jun 2026 (three cycles)
- Temporarily raise our credit cap to $500,000 until 30Jun2026

Also, for VAT reclaims on our side, our tax advisor (cc'd Oliver) needs a simple vendor VAT evidence pack showing: place-of-supply treatment, VAT registration details for Redwood UK/EU entity (if applicable), and sample invoice fields. Can you supply that documentation or a form we can use to satisfy local reclaim requirements?

We'd also like clarity on invoice dating (invoice date vs. service delivery date) — our Treasury prefers invoice date aligned to month-end.

Appreciate a quick yes/no on the credit amount and whether you can produce the VAT evidence pack today or tomorrow. If easier, happy to jump on a 15-min call.

Thanks,
Jenny Park
Finance Manager, Lumos Health
finance@lumoshealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Park <finance@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net60 and credit increase (Q2 usage spike)

Hi Jenny — thanks for the clear note and for looping Oliver. Congrats on the fast ramp. A few proposals from our side to balance cashflow and risk: 

1) Temporary term: We can accommodate a temporary move to Net45 for the next three cycles (Apr–Jun). Net60 is tougher on our side without additional mitigations; Net45 provides a reasonable compromise.

2) Credit increase: We can provisionally raise Lumos' credit cap to $400,000 immediately, subject to a brief credit check and a signed amended Master Services Agreement (MSA) addendum. If you can share a recent AP aging or a short corporate credit reference, we can expedite. We cannot approve $500k immediately without additional underwriting.

3) Invoice dating: We can honor invoice dates aligned to month-end (invoice date = last day of month) provided the billing window and usage reporting are finalized 5 business days prior. That should satisfy Treasury collections.

4) VAT evidence: Attached is a short VAT evidence template and an export-ready example invoice. I asked our tax team for Redwood entity VAT IDs; if needed we can provide a signed letter confirming place-of-supply treatment for software services in the EU.

I'm attaching a provisional invoice schedule that shows how Net45 would flow for Apr–Jun and the temporary credit headroom.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm whether Net45 is acceptable (temporary) and whether the provisional $400k cap is workable.
- If yes, Marissa (cc'd) will draft an MSA addendum for signature and we'll run the credit check.

We want to be pragmatic — happy to do the short call if you prefer.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
[attachment: Provisional-invoice-schedule-Q2.xlsx]

Team — looping you in. Lumos asked for Net60 + $500k cap; Aditya countered with temporary Net45 + $400k provisional cap + quick credit check. Key decision items: 

- Legal (Priyom): can you confirm required language for a 90-day MSA addendum to cap the temporary term and include a rollback clause (auto-revert to standard Net30 after 30Jun2026 unless otherwise approved)? Also need a clause waiving late fees for first two cycles if they provide staged deposit for overages.

- Accounts/AM (Marissa): you will own the credit check and the MSA execution. Please confirm what documentation we need from Lumos to run the underwriting (AP aging, two bank refs, or audited FY). If they push to $500k we need CFO sign-off (Carlos Mendes is cc'd earlier).

Risk notes: Lumos is healthy by usage metrics but the rapid ramp means collections exposure. Recommend we tie the provisional cap increase to either a) a 30% upfront deposit on usage over $300k in a given month or b) a P-Card guarantee / signed promissory addendum.

If you approve, Marissa, please prepare the MSA addendum draft and Priyom prepare the short legal note — want to close by EOD Fri.

Thanks,
Marcus
VP, Finance Operations

Aditya — thanks for the quick follow-up and the attachments. We discussed internally and can accept the temporary Net45 for Apr–Jun 2026 and the provisional $400k cap, provided: 

- Redwood confirms the credit check is non-invasive and that no public filing is required;
- We will provide the AP aging and a bank reference by EOD Mon 20Apr2026;
- We will supply the VAT documents Oliver requested (expected tomorrow).

One small ask: can the waiver of late fees be included for the first two cycles? That would help our Treasury while we adjust collections. If legal flags this, happy to accept a capped waiver or a short grace period instead.

On invoice dating — confirmed: invoice date = last day of month works for us.

If you can circulate the MSA addendum and run the credit check once we drop the docs in, we should be able to sign by Tue 21Apr and hit your timeline. Thanks for being flexible here.

Best,
Jenny Park
Finance Manager, Lumos Health
